key_insight: Sandwich heterostructures can either strongly reshape non-van der Waals 2D materials through chemical bonding or largely preserve them through van der Waals encapsulation.
engineering_relevance: Interface selection offers a route to tuning nanoscale electronic and magnetic behavior while choosing between strong coupling and structural protection.
method: Use ab initio density functional theory.
Compare purely non-vdW trilayers with hybrid vdW/non-vdW/vdW stacks.
Analyze reconstruction, binding, electronic structure, and magnetic coupling.
evidence_signal: The calculations indicate absolute binding energies up to an order of magnitude larger than conventional vdW heterostructures, alongside electronic hybridization, band-gap changes, and tunable interlayer magnetic coupling.
watch_item: The abstract reports computational predictions but does not establish experimental synthesis feasibility or device-level performance.
paper_title: Mixing and Preserving Properties of Non-van der Waals 2D Materials in Sandwich-like Heterostructures
